extras: Measurements and annotations are approximate; large models may cause memory issues on mobile.
intentEvidence: View CAD models directly inside Obsidian in an interactive 3D viewer.
problem: Users need a way to view and interact with complex CAD models like STEP and FreeCAD files directly within the Obsidian environment.
summary: Interactive 3D viewer that allows users to open and view STEP, FCStd, OBJ, and STL CAD models directly within Obsidian.
